scope_note: The party's weekly organ, issue of 17 April 2005 (archived Last-Modified 20 April 2005), recorded as a raw Internet Archive capture of 26 April 2005. A report of the public meeting in New Delhi on 11 April 2005 that concluded the 18th Congress; the day is printed in its text.

rows.role_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of India (Marxist)
rows.text: People's Democracy reports that the message to the public meeting in New Delhi 'on April 11' marking the conclusion of the 18th Congress was that of 'the former CPI(M) general secretary, Harkishan Singh Surjeet', who presided over the meeting.

rows.role_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of India (Marxist)
rows.text: At the same public meeting of 11 April 2005, People's Democracy reports, Surjeet 'was escorted to the podium by the newly-elected general secretary, Prakash Karat', and later 'the newly elected general secretary, Prakash Karat was called on to address' the crowd.
